legs.name: jammi-ai gpu_capability generic sweep (prove-script --skip capability_surface rule)
legs.cmd: cargo test -p jammi-ai --features cuda,flash-attn,live-gpu-tests --test gpu_capability -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 --skip capability_surface
legs.note: 23 passed, 2 filtered out. Strict mode deliberately NOT set here: capability_surface.rs asserts strict mode itself, so it is name-excluded exactly as ci/scripts/runpod_gpu_prove.sh does, and proven by the strict leg below.

legs.name: jammi-ai capability_surface, STRICT (JAMMI_KERNELS_STRICT=1)
legs.cmd: JAMMI_KERNELS_STRICT=1 cargo test -p jammi-ai --features cuda,flash-attn,live-gpu-tests --test gpu_capability capability_surface -- --nocapture
legs.note: 2 passed (capability_surface::capability_surface + capability_surface::manifest_capability_categories_match_probed_ops_by_kind), 23 filtered out -- a zero-test match is forced to fail by the harness guard, mirroring the prove script's own 'running 0 tests' check. On-device proof of the manifest cross-check by (op,parent), the F9 serial slot, and the dtype-neutral report keys under bf16 AND f16 (cast_scale_bf16_f32 / cast_add_bf16 are CUDA-only: this is their first execution).
